Definition: Elishama, the name of seven Israelites
BiblicalUsage: Elishama = "my God has heard"; 1) an Ephraimite chief in the wilderness; 2) a son of David; 3) Jehoiakim's secretary; 4) a priest who taught the law; 5) a man of Judah
